title: Mortgage Prequalification Customer Change and Reverification Request
subtitle: A controlled change request for an early mortgage affordability and eligibility conversation based on stated or identified information, clearly separating assumptions, verified evidence, loan program screening, credit review, property unknowns, and non-commitment status, carrying the record from secure identity and evidence through qualified decision, exception escalation, customer communication, and accountable closeout.
description: Original high-value Mortgage Prequalification workflow for an early mortgage affordability and eligibility conversation based on stated or identified information, clearly separating assumptions, verified evidence, loan program screening, credit review, property unknowns, and non-commitment status. It is designed to preserve current and requested values, verify identity and authority, assess every downstream effect, repeat stale controls, authorize or reject the amendment, update systems, notify the customer, and verify the audit trail while minimizing sensitive data and preserving a defensible evidence trail.
use_case: Use when a mortgage lending specialist must preserve current and requested values, verify identity and authority, assess every downstream effect, repeat stale controls, authorize or reject the amendment, update systems, notify the customer, and verify the audit trail for one prequalification request. Closure requires a supported outcome, secure evidence references, customer or recipient communication, disposition of every exception, and an accountable handoff.

sections.title: Mortgage Prequalification change request identity and routing
sections.guidance: Open one traceable record, use secure references, and assign an accountable qualified owner before collecting or changing financial information.

blocks.label: Mortgage Prequalification record and responsible parties
Customer Change and Reverification Request timing and route
Secure-record boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not enter Social Security numbers, login credentials, full account or routing numbers, full credit-report contents, authentication secrets, or source documents here. Store sensitive evidence only in the approved system and record its secure reference.

sections.title: Mortgage Prequalification facts and evidence for change request
sections.guidance: Capture facts specific to this financial workflow, distinguish stated from verified information, and leave an evidence route for every material conclusion.

blocks.label: Mortgage Prequalification transaction or account profile
Mortgage Prequalification evidence checkpoints
items: Stated versus verified income sources are clearly distinguished
Asset source, availability, reserves, and gift assumptions are separated
Recurring debts, housing obligations, and contingent liabilities are recorded
Credit review authorization and credit-report date are stored by reference
Property price, taxes, insurance, dues, and occupancy remain explicit assumptions
Loan program and eligibility discussion is marked preliminary
Rate, points, mortgage insurance, and closing-cost assumptions show dates
Prequalification is not represented as a guaranteed loan offer or property approval
blocks.guidance: Check only when the item is present, current, and linked. Describe limitations or contradictions in the exception record.

blocks.label: Mortgage Prequalification quantitative and source-evidence register
blocks.guidance: Use one row per material input or evidence item; preserve the source period and verification status.

blocks.label: Borrowing goals, property assumptions, income and asset structure, credit scope, program questions, and limits on the prequalification

fields.label: Mortgage Prequalification context and evidence limitations

sections.title: Mortgage Prequalification change request analysis and control record
sections.guidance: Use the blocks below to preserve current and requested values, verify identity and authority, assess every downstream effect, repeat stale controls, authorize or reject the amendment, update systems, notify the customer, and verify the audit trail. Preserve objective evidence, uncertainty, ownership, and due points.

blocks.label: Requested amendment and reverification scope
Mortgage Prequalification before-and-after change register
Mortgage Prequalification downstream impact and rework review
items: Target price, loan amount, down payment, product, term, or occupancy changes
Income source, employment, business ownership, or continuity changes
Assets, gift funds, reserves, debts, or monthly obligations change
Credit report, score, dispute, freeze, alert, or authorization changes
Property type, location, taxes, insurance, dues, or use assumptions change
Interest rate, points, mortgage insurance, or cost assumptions expire
Application status crosses from inquiry or prequalification into a regulated application
Letter amount, wording, recipient, expiration, or conditions need revision
blocks.guidance: Check each affected area and assign the required repeat review or system update.

blocks.label: Reverification, system update, notification, and rollback log
Customer explanation, impact analysis, rejected alternatives, and rollback plan

sections.title: Mortgage Prequalification stop conditions, exceptions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Stop processing when authority, identity, evidence, safety, legality, fairness, privacy, fraud, or financial-crime controls are unresolved. Record facts rather than unsupported conclusions.

blocks.label: Stop and escalate when any condition is present
items: Prequalification is described as a commitment, guarantee, or property approval
Stated and verified financial information are blended or mislabeled
Property tax, insurance, association dues, or mortgage insurance assumptions are missing
Income stability, source, continuity, or self-employment analysis needs specialist review
Asset source, large deposit, gift, reserve, or ownership evidence is unresolved
Credit report, debt, dispute, fraud alert, freeze, or consent issue remains open
Program eligibility, occupancy, property type, or geographic assumptions changed
Applicant treatment or decision factors raise fair-lending or policy concerns
Requester identity, authority, current value, or requested value cannot be verified
A downstream system, notice, payment, approval, or control impact remains unknown
blocks.guidance: A checked item requires an immediate protective action, named owner, qualified review route, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Customer Change and Reverification Request exception and escalation register
Objective facts, affected activity, containment, notifications, and review needed
Qualified-review and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This template records operational facts and does not determine legal rights, creditworthiness, regulatory duties, fraud, sanctions status, or professional conclusions. Follow current institution policy and applicable requirements; route legal, compliance, underwriting, fraud, tax, accounting, or other professional questions to authorized reviewers.

sections.title: Mortgage Prequalification decision, conditions, and accountable authorization
sections.guidance: Record the qualified decision separately from preliminary analysis, identify every condition, and prevent execution beyond the approved scope.

blocks.label: Customer Change and Reverification Request qualified decision
Mortgage Prequalification decision and execution conditions
items: Before-and-after values and affected systems are independently reconciled
Customer notification and rollback or correction path are ready
Letter amount and assumptions match the qualified prequalification review
Information basis is labeled stated, reviewed, or verified for each material input
Letter expiration and material-change conditions are explicit
No property, appraisal, title, insurance, or final-underwriting approval is implied
Required adverse-action or incomplete-application routing is reviewed by qualified staff
Borrower receives the letter and limitations through an approved channel
blocks.guidance: Check only controls supported by cited evidence; unresolved items remain open conditions.

blocks.label: Evidence considered, reasons, limits, alternatives, and required follow-up
Preparation, qualified review, and independent authorization
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and scope; they do not replace required agreements, disclosures, notices, or system approvals.

blocks.label: Decision-use limitation
blocks.guidance: Do not use this Mortgage Prequalification record as a substitute for a required application, contract, disclosure, adverse-action notice, payment instruction, credit report, or specialist determination. Execute only the action evidenced in the approved system of record.

sections.title: Mortgage Prequalification completion, evidence reconciliation, and handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when the outcome is evidenced, remaining limitations are visible, customer communication is traceable, and every open action has an accountable owner.

blocks.label: Customer Change and Reverification Request outcome and primary handoff
Mortgage Prequalification closeout evidence
items: Prequalification letter and assumption record use the same amount and expiration
Stated and verified information remain visibly distinguished
Borrower received limitations and next-step requirements
Any incomplete or adverse outcome followed the qualified notice process
No property or final-credit approval is implied in the record
Credit, evidence, communication, and retention references are linked
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items require an exception disposition or a documented reopen trigger.
